name: Quinn Taylor
summary: Senior construction safety manager with experience developing site safety plans, leading trainings, and improving leading indicators across multiple projects. My prefer pronounce is him or he her.

experience.title: Safety Manager
bullets: Developed and enforced site safety plans, daily JHAs, and toolbox talk programs
Conducted site audits and coached supervisors to correct hazards and prevent incidents
Tracked leading indicators and implemented interventions to improve safety performance

experience.title: Safety Coordinator
bullets: Supported incident investigations and documented corrective/preventive actions
Maintained training records and ensured subcontractor compliance with safety requirements
Coordinated safety orientations and supported pre-task planning with field teams

projects.name: Leading Indicator Dashboard
projects.impact: Improved visibility into safety trends and proactive interventions
